subject: I wasn't going to send this confession
preview_text: The one feature I almost removed from the app because it scared me too much. You need to see this.
body_paragraphs: I'm sitting here at 2 AM, staring at my screen, wondering if I should even send this. I don't usually write emails like this. It feels too raw, too real. But something happened last week that changed my mind completely.

A user emailed me. She said the pattern detection feature caught something she'd missed for two years. It wasn't about one bad text. It was about the slow, quiet erosion of her confidence across hundreds of conversations. The app showed her the map of her own heartbreak. I built this tool to help people, but sometimes the truth it reveals is terrifying. And that's exactly why it exists.

Most people use the scanner for single screenshots. They're checking a specific weird text. But the real power—the scary, life-changing power—is in the dashboard. It connects the dots you can't see when you're in the middle of it. It shows the patterns, not just the moments. The toxicity score isn't a number; it's a measurement of your peace.

Open the app right now. Go to your Relationship Health Dashboard. Look at the pattern timeline. Just look. See what it shows you. P.S. That user? She wrote back yesterday. She said thank you for the courage to build the feature I was afraid of. Now it's your turn.
